topic: Multi-camera 180-degree line-of-action continuity and screen-order invariant
topic_zh: 多机位 180 度动作轴线连续性与屏幕左右方向守恒
scope: Deterministic 2D half-plane determinant check, 4-shot camera basis NDC projection and Node CPU solving. No SynCamMaster multi-view diffusion execution, gaze tracking or automated narrative editing.

checks.name: projection-equivalence-128
checks.detail: 128 analytic basis and 4x4 cofactor projections agree within 1e-12 NDC

checks.name: projection-equivalence-1024
checks.detail: 1024 analytic basis and 4x4 cofactor projections agree within 1e-12 NDC

checks.name: projection-equivalence-8192
checks.detail: 8192 analytic basis and 4x4 cofactor projections agree within 1e-12 NDC

checks.name: same-side-zero-flips
checks.detail: 121 sampled frames across 4 shots preserve x_NDC(A) < x_NDC(B) (0 flips)

checks.name: crossed-axis-flips-exposed
checks.detail: axis-crossing Shot 3 (+142°) reverses left-right screen order on 30 sampled frames

checks.name: cut-continuity-preserved
checks.detail: Shot 2 to Shot 3 cut preserves Actor A on screen left and Actor B on screen right

checks.name: cut-reversal-detected
checks.detail: negative half-plane sign in Shot 3 immediately flips Actor A to the right of Actor B

checks.name: exact-reverse-matrix
checks.detail: reverse timestamp visitation reproduces the exact Actor A world matrix

checks.name: atomic-azimuth-rejection
checks.detail: unsafe 135-degree cut azimuth is rejected while valid camera rig remains

checks.name: geometry-matrix-conformance
checks.detail: rendered Actor A world matrix matches independent blocking coordinates

checks.name: mobile-layout
checks.detail: 390px continuity stage controls fit without horizontal overflow

checks.name: reduced-motion
checks.detail: reduced motion starts still and manual shot inspection remains available

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Orthonormal camera basis dot-product projection versus general 4x4 cofactor matrix inversion, not neural multi-camera synthesis or GPU rendering.

protocol.function: action vector u=B-A → half-plane check s(c)>0 → orthonormal camera basis → invariant screen order x_A < x_B

robustness.name: Sampled 4-shot frames preserve left-to-right screen order under reverse visitation

good_fit: Pre-validating camera cuts before multi-view video synthesis
Preventing screen-direction flips in automated shot planners
not_for: Automated emotional performance or facial gaze synthesis
